alignments.note: Outer construct noun with a supplied *the*; no article morpheme stands in this chain (rule 29).
Middle noun takes its *of* (rule 19) and the second supplied English *the* rule 29 allows a multi-level chain.
The ASV recasts this waw's clause as a subordinate one and writes *that* for it; the connective the ASV has written for a waw is never `added` (rules 14, 55).
Negative takes the word carrying the negation, *none*, which fuses the negation with the indefinite subject English supplies (rule 35).
Imperfect with its modal and the phrasal particle *in* (rule 44), headed on the lexical verb; discontinuous under rule 25.
Articleless adjective recast as a relative clause takes the supplied relative together with the copula rule 20 supplies (rule 41), headed on the word carrying its lexeme.

כָל־דָּבָר rendered by the single word *anything*, which carries both the quantification and the noun; rule 30's condition is met and the head goes to the governing morpheme, the quantifier standing first (rule 23).

review_notes: *that* is the connective the ASV writes for the waw of a clause it has recast as subordinate (rules 14, 55); *none* is the negative's, being the word that carries the negation (rule 35).
כָל־דָּבָר fuses to *anything* under rule 30; the competing division would give *any* to כֹּל and *thing* to דָּבָר, but the ASV writes one word and neither morpheme owns a part of it.
